title: pr-pane 0.6.1: say when a branch is behind but not required to be up to date
summary: The up-to-date gate showed green 'up to date' on a branch 6 commits behind its base.
description: evolv-marketplace's v0.5.0 test on evolv-marketplace#18: gates showed 'up to date' as met while the branch line said '1 ahead · 6 behind'. The gate followed mergeStateStatus, which reads BEHIND only when the base requires an up-to-date branch; otherwise it reads CLEAN even when the head is behind.

acceptanceCriteria.text: When the compare API says the head is behind and GitHub does not require an up-to-date branch, the gate reads "<n> behind (not required)" in amber, not green
When GitHub requires it (mergeStateStatus BEHIND), the gate reads "<n> behind base" as a blocker
The Mermaid export gives that gate its own warn class
Tests cover both cases in the pane gates and the Mermaid text

implementationNotes: Design: 'not required' in every non-BEHIND case, including unreadable rules. GitHub's mergeStateStatus is authoritative: it reads BEHIND whenever an up-to-date branch is required, rulesets or not, so CLEAN with behind > 0 means it isn't required. That's simpler than evolv-marketplace's 'rules unknown' variant and accurate.

Evidence: diagram.test.ts covers CLEAN plus behind 6 ('6 behind (not required)', isWarning, tone warn), BEHIND plus behind 6 ('6 behind base', blocker), behind 0 and a compare error ('up to date'), and the Mermaid ':::warn' class with classDef warn in the snapshot. The mounted pane at 80 and 40 columns now shows '3 behind (not required)' from the compare stub. 54/54, tsc 0 errors, validate --strict.
finalSummary: Shipped in pr-pane 0.6.1 (PR #11, tag v0.6.1). The up-to-date gate takes the behind count from the compare API: '<n> behind (not required)' in amber when GitHub doesn't require an up-to-date branch, '<n> behind base' as a blocker when it does (mergeStateStatus BEHIND). The Mermaid export gets a warn class. Verified by unit and mounted-pane tests, tsc, validate --strict and CI. Reported by evolv-marketplace from evolv-marketplace#18 (1 ahead, 6 behind, shown green).
